input.quote: 13.5 SFJ Representation, Warranty and Covenant. SFJ hereby represents, warrants and covenants that it will have, as and when needed, sufficient funds to satisfy its obligations hereunder.
input.rationale: SFJ's only warranty is the funding covenant at Section 13.5; nothing in Article 3 or Article 13 warrants the conformity of the SFJ Services (CRO oversight and execution of the Clinical Trials in the SFJ Territory), and Section 13.6.2 disclaims all warranties except those set out in Article 13. That is walk-away territory, so we insert the fallback warranty into Article 13, where the 13.6.2 carve-out preserves it: 90-day conformance of the SFJ Services and of any SFJ-provided software to its documentation, with re-performance, repair or replacement, or refund of amounts paid as the remedy. The software limb is drafted conditionally because the Agreement identifies no SFJ software or deliverables, so it costs PB nothing while closing the gap in operative language.

ops.text: SFJ Services Warranty. SFJ hereby represents and warrants that (a) the SFJ Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner and, for a period of ninety (90) days following performance, will conform in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement, and (b) any software provided by SFJ under this Agreement will conform to its documentation for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery. For any breach of this warranty, SFJ will, at its option, re-perform, repair or replace the non-conforming SFJ Services or software, or refund to PB the amounts paid for them.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] SFJ warrants only that it will have sufficient funds, and Section 13.6.2 disclaims every warranty outside Article 13, so the SFJ Services are un-warranted. We added our fallback warranty inside Article 13 (where the disclaimer's carve-out preserves it): conformance of the SFJ Services and of any SFJ software to its documentation, with re-performance, repair or replacement, or refund as the remedy.
proposal.summary: Insert an express SFJ warranty in Article 13: 90-day conformance for SFJ Services and any SFJ software, with repair/replacement or refund remedies.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
